title: The Unity of the Godhead
definition: The unity of the Godhead means that there is only one true God, and the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit are perfectly one in divine being, will, purpose, glory, and work.
summary: Scripture teaches that God is one. The unity of God does not deny the Trinity; it guards believers from thinking of Father, Son, and Spirit as separate gods or competing divine beings.
christFocus: Jesus declared, 'I and the Father are one.' His unity with the Father is seen in His words, works, mission, glory, and saving purpose.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: There is one God. The Father, Son, and Holy Spirit are not divided in purpose or essence. The triune God acts with perfect unity in creation, redemption, and sanctification.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: The unity of the Godhead protects Christian faith from confusion, idolatry, and divided worship. Believers do not trust in competing powers, but in the one living God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship God with undivided devotion. Rest in the united work of Father, Son, and Spirit, and pursue unity with other believers as a reflection of God's own truth and love.
